scope: x86_64 source/manual installation and simulated lifecycle in seven distribution containers; native lifecycle in four
development_flag: The runner records --development for native package versioning only. All source and native rows here test an unreleased development commit.
limits: Development packages still identify the 0.7.1 version constant; not 0.7.2 release assets.
No physical sound device, host home or real user service manager is passed into these containers.
Headless backend packaging; optional upstream GTK GUI build is not qualified by this matrix.
The earlier Ubuntu 24.04 VM user-manager/reboot experiment was not repeated here; its original provenance remains in ../installation/qualification.json.
No host package migration and no release upload, signing or attestation were performed.

Labels.org.opencontainers.image.description:
The Ubuntu container image maintained by Canonical

Ubuntu is a Debian-based Linux operating system that runs from the desktop to the cloud, to all your internet connected things.
It is the world's most popular operating system across public clouds and OpenStack clouds.
It is the number one platform for containers; from Docker to Kubernetes to LXD, Ubuntu can run your containers at scale.
Fast, secure and simple, Ubuntu powers millions of PCs worldwide.
